<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 180.0422587. This value matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the neutral formula C₉H₈O₄ (108 + 8 × 1.007825 + 4 × 15.994915 = 180.04226 Da). The isotope pattern (≈10 % M+1) is consistent with a molecule containing nine carbons. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C9H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H8O4</final_answer>
